column1: # What the game calls each sound, and where the installation keeps it.
#   group <name>  <directory>          every numbered file in it, in order
#   pair  <name>  <normal>  <annoyed>  two existing names, kept apart
# The paths are directories and files in the player's own installation;
# a group's contents are counted there rather than listed here. 'when' is
# empty for a binding every release shares, 'expansion' for one that needs
# Beyond the Dark Portal's recordings, and 'base' for what a release
# without them uses instead. 'tileset:<name>' is applied later, when a map has
# been loaded and the tileset is known: the critter is a sheep in summer, a
# seal in winter, a pig in wasteland and a warthog in swamp, and it is the only
# thing in the game whose sound depends on the ground it stands on.
#   alias <name>  <existing name>     the files that name already holds, and
#                                     its selection pair if it has one
